evidence.reason: The assertion is not vacuous. The sibling 'an observation OPEN failure...' test at lines 812–835 creates its fixture with the same `fixture()` helper used by this test and asserts `f.boundDeps.length` is greater than 0 (line 834) immediately before the identical `every((deps) => deps.observationWriter === undefined)` check (line 835). That demonstrates the fixture's recording worker factory does populate `boundDeps`. The header-append-failure path likewise continues the run and binds workers: the test's own comment at lines 793–796 ('no bound worker may receive the writer') and the analogous run-continues-but-still-binds behavior in the open-failure case both presuppose bound workers. So the every-check at line 798 exercises the intended 'header never landed, so workers didn't receive the writer' behavior and would fail if the writer were wrongly handed off. The finding's premise that `boundDeps` is never populated in this test is contradicted by the supplied code.
